# Rudratosh Shastri

> AI-agent security and full-stack engineer based in Indore, India (~15 years in backend engineering). Technical Lead & Senior Backend Architect at PharmaForceIQ. Creator of buried-injections and taintgate. Founder of Export Bank Statement and Brisk Type. Name is spelled "Rudratosh" (not Rudraksh).

## Open source
- [buried-injections](https://github.com/rudratoshs/buried-injections): MIT benchmark testing 10 prompt-injection detectors against 629 real AgentDojo attacks.
- [taintgate](https://github.com/rudratoshs/taintgate): MIT provenance-aware policy gate that blocks AI-agent tool calls built from untrusted input.

## Products
- [Export Bank Statement](https://www.exportbankstatement.com/): converts PDF bank statements to Excel, CSV, QBO, OFX, QIF.
- [Brisk Type](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/brisktype): typing/productivity product launched on Product Hunt.
